name: FINAL TRADING SIGNAL & STRATEGY ENGINE
purpose: Terminal PSY29 opportunity engine. Scan all 29 canonical stocks, use verified Stage 5-19 evidence to identify qualifying opportunities, select the applicable deterministic strategy, and emit every new qualifying signal with the strategy-owned exact entry, stop-loss, and take-profit levels.

stage19_startup_policy.meaning: Insufficient Stage 19 history means transition analysis is unavailable. It is not, by itself, evidence that an otherwise independently valid Stage 20 setup is invalid.

BREAKOUT.direction_rule: LONG when bullish breakout structure; SHORT when bearish breakout structure.
BREAKOUT.entry_rule: Use the breakout boundary plus the configured confirmation buffer from the strategy fixture/live strategy inputs.
BREAKOUT.stop_rule: Use the breakout invalidation level defined by the strategy: opposite side of the broken structural boundary.
BREAKOUT.target_rule: For a confirmed live breakout, use the Stage 11 current-session structural high for LONG or current-session structural low for SHORT as the observable post-breakout objective. The objective must lie beyond the entry; otherwise the candidate remains NO_SIGNAL.

BREAKDOWN.direction_rule: SHORT on verified bearish breakdown structure.
BREAKDOWN.entry_rule: Use the breakdown boundary plus the configured confirmation buffer from the strategy fixture/live strategy inputs.
BREAKDOWN.stop_rule: Use the breakdown invalidation level defined by the strategy.
BREAKDOWN.target_rule: For a confirmed live breakdown, use the Stage 11 current-session structural low for SHORT or current-session structural high for LONG as the observable post-breakdown objective. The objective must lie beyond the entry; otherwise the candidate remains NO_SIGNAL.

CONTINUATION.direction_rule: LONG for verified bullish continuation; SHORT for verified bearish continuation.
CONTINUATION.entry_rule: Use the strategy-defined continuation trigger level.
CONTINUATION.stop_rule: Use the strategy-defined continuation invalidation swing.

RETEST.direction_rule: Follow the direction of the validated retest structure.
RETEST.entry_rule: Use the retest confirmation level defined by the strategy.
RETEST.stop_rule: Use the retest invalidation level defined by the strategy.
RETEST.target_rule: Use the next strategy-defined structural objective.

fail_closed_rules: Canonical universe must be exactly 29 unique stocks.
Required upstream evidence must cover all 29 stocks.
A signal requires a valid strategy-owned entry, stop-loss and take-profit.
Missing strategy-owned levels produce NO SIGNAL for that candidate, never invented levels.
Long geometry must be stop_loss < entry < take_profit.
Short geometry must be take_profit < entry < stop_loss.
A traded stock is not permanently suppressed after its prior setup is invalidated/completed.
No daily signal-count limit may suppress a qualifying independent setup.
Any structural or provenance failure is fail-closed.
INSUFFICIENT_TRANSITION_EVIDENCE means transition evidence is unavailable, not that the independent Stage 20 setup is invalid.
Stage 20 must never fabricate transition evidence to replace insufficient Stage 19 history.
